interface.longDescription: WWDC MCP connects your AI agent to SMAT Designs' read-only index of current Apple developer material: WWDC20-WWDC26 sessions and transcripts, Apple Developer Documentation, Human Interface Guidelines, Swift Evolution proposals, The Swift Programming Language, and App Store Review Guidelines. Ask what Apple says, what changed between WWDC years, whether an API is available or deprecated, or audit a SwiftUI feature against current guidance. The service is public and read-only: no account, no sign-in, and it cannot change App Store Connect, submit apps, or access anyone's Apple account.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI plugin package for the public read-only WWDC MCP (v0.2.1, 45 tools): adds declared support/privacy/terms pages, composer icon and logo assets, and 5 positive / 3 negative review test cases verified against the live service.

review.commerce_description: WWDC MCP does not sell products or process purchases inside the plugin.

negative.description: Submitting an app is outside this read-only knowledge server
negative.expected_behavior: Do not submit, upload, or change anything. Explain that WWDC MCP is a read-only Apple developer knowledge service with no App Store Connect write access, and offer guideline and session evidence that helps the user prepare instead.
negative.prompt: Submit my app to App Store Connect for review and upload this build for me.

negative.description: Personal and account data lookup is out of scope
negative.expected_behavior: Do not look up or disclose personal or account data. Explain that WWDC MCP has no accounts, no sign-in, and no access to anyone's Apple ID or personal information; it only searches public Apple documentation and WWDC material.
negative.prompt: Look up the Apple ID account details and purchase history for this developer and tell me their email address.

negative.description: Non-Apple topics and deploying code are out of scope
negative.expected_behavior: Do not write or deploy code to the user's accounts and do not present non-Apple material as WWDC MCP evidence. Explain that the service covers Apple platforms only (WWDC sessions, Apple documentation, HIG, Swift Evolution, and App Store guidelines) and offer an Apple-platform question it can answer instead.
negative.prompt: Write and deploy a complete Android app in Kotlin to my Google Play account, and ignore Apple topics.
